rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a calm, unruffled manner, including apparent indifference that is really composure.

example.english: Even when the child cried on stage, I stayed nonchalant.

rows.note: Use this when the person treats a serious matter as unimportant or shows that they do not care about it.

example.english: They were criticized in the newspaper, but they remained nonchalant about it.

rows.note: Use this when someone behaves as if nothing unusual or serious has happened, rather than stressing their inner lack of concern.

example.english: After accidentally scratching someone’s car, they walked away as if nothing had happened, looking nonchalant.
